test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H were sitting around a square table, facing the centre. Some of them were sitting at the corners, while some were sitting at the exact centre of the sides. Only A was sitting between G and D. C was sitting fourth to the left of G. Only E was sitting between B and C. H was sitting to the immediate left of D. B was sitting second to the right of G. D is sitting at one of the corners. Who was sitting third to the right of D?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H.

1) D is sitting at one of the corners.

2) H was sitting to the immediate left of D.

3) Only A was sitting between G and D.

4) B was sitting second to the right of G.
